title: Exploring the Design Space of Permutation Diffusion LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.20635v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Permutation generation with language models requires both text-conditioned ranking and a global one-to-one assignment between candidates and output positions. We study this problem through three diffusion-LLM parameterizations: hard-assignment prediction over shuffled candidate-index sequences, soft-assignment prediction over doubly stochastic matrices, and direct ordering-score prediction followed by sorting. The three families place permutation constraints at different stages of prediction and decoding and therefore support different training objectives and sampling procedures. We evaluate these designs on recommendation reranking across three Amazon domains with candidate sets of size 10 and 20. At one function evaluation, the hard- and soft-assignment variants achieve Recall@1 comparable to a constrained masked-diffusion baseline, whereas direct ordering-score prediction guarantees valid permutations without Hungarian assignment or

translated_title: 探索置换扩散大语言模型的设计空间
translated_abstract: 使用语言模型进行置换生成，既需要文本条件化的排序能力，也需要候选对象与输出位置之间的全局一一对应分配。我们通过三种扩散大语言模型参数化方法来研究这一问题：在打乱的候选索引序列上进行硬分配预测、在双随机矩阵上进行软分配预测，以及直接预测排序分数后再进行排序。这三种方法族将置换约束置于预测和解码的不同阶段，因此支持不同的训练目标和采样流程。我们在三个亚马逊领域上评估了这些设计，候选集大小分别为10和20。在单次函数评估下，硬分配和软分配变体取得了与受限掩码扩散基线相当的Recall@1，而直接排序分数预测无需匈牙利分配算法即可保证生成有效的置换……
tldr: 该论文系统探索了三种用于排列生成的扩散大语言模型参数化设计（硬分配、软分配和直接排序分数预测），发现硬/软分配方法在单次函数评估下达到与掩码扩散基线相当的推荐重排性能，而直接分数预测无需匈牙利算法即可保证有效排列。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically explores three diffusion-LLM parameterizations for permutation generation—hard assignment, soft assignment via doubly stochastic matrices, and direct ordering-score prediction—showing that hard/soft assignment variants achieve Recall@1 comparable to a constrained masked-diffusion baseline at one function evaluation, while direct score prediction guarantees valid permutations without Hungarian assignment.
